steps.title: See today's market at a glance
steps.narration: The homepage opens straight to today's market score. There is nothing to set up and nothing to wait for.
steps.point_out: The market score, already filled in on the very first look.

steps.title: See the record behind every claim
steps.narration: The Evidence page keeps a running list of certified claims. A pattern only counts as proven once it earns a place here.
steps.point_out: The list of certified claims, fully loaded and ready to inspect.

steps.title: Check one claim's full track record
steps.narration: Each claim carries its own history of past pullbacks and recoveries. This table shows phase-by-phase risk metrics for holding the pattern.
steps.point_out: A full table of real numbers showing how this signal has performed during past downturns, not a blank space.

steps.title: Confirm every kind of claim still works
steps.narration: Some claims come from different research tools entirely. They kept working correctly through this round of changes too.
steps.point_out: A combination-research claim card, fully populated with real data.

steps.title: Browse the ranked stock list
steps.narration: The Stocks page lists ranked companies right away. Familiar names show up immediately with current prices.
steps.point_out: A ranked list of real stocks with current pricing information.

steps.title: Look up a past day instantly
steps.narration: Opening one exact day from years ago, February 15, 2018, is instant. It was already worked out when the data first came in, so nothing needs recomputing now.
steps.point_out: A stored snapshot from that exact day, served instantly without waiting.

steps.title: See the market's forward-tested track record
steps.narration: The Backtest page shows how past signals actually played out afterward, built entirely from real, stored results. No computation happens on request.
steps.point_out: The forward-tested evidence, filled with real figures that were all precomputed at ingest time.

steps.title: See background work disclosed honestly
steps.narration: The Data Manager page has its own section showing what work is happening right now. Background computation is never hidden from the user.
steps.point_out: The background-compute status badge and a clear explanation of any in-progress work.
